data.long_meaning: Rashik is a Sanskrit and Hindu name meaning 'Ruler of the Cosmos'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rashtra', which means 'King' or 'Country', and 'Ishvara', which means 'God'. This name signifies the divine ruler of the universe, and is a symbol of power, wisdom, and spiritual growth. The name Rashik carries the meaning “Ruler of the Cosmos” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Bengali. Parents who choose Rashik usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the cosmos and live with faith, good character and purpose.
